premises.text: Orbital debris at extreme speeds can destroy satellites and trigger Kessler syndrome that renders orbits unusable
premises.evidence_span: a small fragment the size of a penny can destroy a multimillion-dollar satellite

premises.text: Traditional manual collision-avoidance processes are falling apart under rising launch volume because they are error-prone and slow
premises.evidence_span: the processes that satellite operators have traditionally used to avoid collisions are falling apart because they're manual and they're prone to human error and delays

premises.text: Pathfinder autonomously reduces response time to potential collisions by more than 90% with alerts, options, and analysis
premises.evidence_span: Pathfinder, an autonomous satellite collision avoidance solution that reduces the response time to potential collision events by more than 90%

premises.text: Near-real-time multi-source data feeds trajectory and optimization models that minimize collision risk and fuel use
premises.evidence_span: massive amounts of data from solar radiation pressure to onboard GPS data to radar data ingested in near real time

premises.evidence_span: Gamit ensures safety of flight for launch vehicle and the onboard payload
